summary: Closed all three WAVE-064 options, archived settled work, gave every task a visible status, and rewrote the Queen's reports as prose that explains her reasoning.

defects_found.title: Settled tasks never left the working view
defects_found.fix: DelegatedTaskState.isArchivable plus registry.open / .archived and a collapsible Archive section capped at 50.
defects_found.lesson: failed is terminal but deliberately not archivable: a failure nobody has looked at is still work, and filing it away silently is how it never gets looked at.

defects_found.title: No cost signal
defects_found.fix: SSE .usage accumulated in QueenWorkerTranscript, recorded additively per task, surfaced live in the banner.
defects_found.lesson: Additive because a rejected bee is re-briefed in the same chat and its second attempt is not free.

defects_found.title: Stalled bees held slots forever
defects_found.fix: reapStalledWorkers on every wake, only for tasks with no live stream.

defects_found.title: Reports read like a status table
defects_found.fix: QueenReviewDigest rewritten as prose with one explanatory analogy per report.

defects_found.title: The Queen reported measurements that were never taken
defects_found.cause: committedFiles nil and 0 were treated identically, and token counts printed 0 when the provider emitted no usage at all.
defects_found.fix: nil now reads 'I have not tallied its branch yet'; zero-valued metrics are omitted rather than printed.
defects_found.lesson: Printing 0 for an absent measurement turns a gap in instrumentation into an accusation about the worker. This is the same class of error as reporting a build green because no FAIL line was printed.

defects_found.title: The wake could describe a task whose commit had not run
defects_found.cause: transition to awaitingReview happened before QueenBranchCommitter finished.
defects_found.fix: Commit and tally first, transition second.

verification.delegate_probe: delegate -> work -> commit -> auto-accept observed; queen.auto_accept logged with files:1
verification.visual: Swarm strip, Archive section, status pills, and the worker-chat task banner all confirmed on screen; conversational digest read back in the Queen chat

not_done: No commit: the working tree still carries unrelated in-flight work from earlier sessions.
Cost is in tokens, not currency - no per-provider price table yet.
The OTLP exporter is written and wired but was not exercised against a live collector.
